repairs.failure_pattern: A multimodal forward pass concatenates or selects projected tabular, image, gated, or cross-attended tensors whose total width differs from the first classifier linear layer, causing a matrix-multiplication shape mismatch.
repair_steps: Write down the output width of every tabular projection, image projection, attention output, and fused representation.
Choose one explicit final representation and remove redundant modality tensors that are already encoded in it.
Set the classifier's first linear layer input width from the chosen representation's computed dimension rather than a stale constant.
Run a representative batch through the forward pass and assert that final_features.shape[-1] equals classifier[0].in_features before training.
repairs.root_cause: The fusion representation was changed without updating the classifier contract, or modality projections already represented inside a fused tensor were concatenated again.
repairs.title: Confirmed: derive multimodal classifier input width from the actual fusion output
repairs.when_to_use: Use when multimodal model_forward fails with incompatible mat1 and mat2 dimensions and the observed final feature width differs from the classifier's declared input width.

repairs.failure_pattern: The backward pass fails with 'grad can be implicitly created only for scalar outputs' after MixUp or CutMix combines unreduced per-sample classification losses.
repair_steps: Compute the loss for each augmented target using the same per-sample reduction.
Combine the two loss tensors with the MixUp or CutMix coefficient.
Apply an explicit mean reduction to the combined loss before backward.
Assert that loss.ndim is zero in the training loop, including augmented and non-augmented branches.
repairs.root_cause: The augmentation criterion preserves the batch dimension because its component loss uses no reduction, and the weighted combination is passed directly to backward.
repairs.title: Confirmed: reduce augmented per-sample losses to a scalar before backpropagation
repairs.when_to_use: Use when MixUp or CutMix training reaches the backward pass with a vector-valued loss and raises the scalar-output gradient error.

repairs.failure_pattern: SMOTE fails inside a stratified training fold because its requested nearest-neighbor count, including the sample itself, exceeds the number of examples in at least one class.
repair_steps: Count samples per class after creating the training fold and before applying SMOTE.
Set k_neighbors no larger than the minimum supported value, specifically at most min_class_count minus one.
Skip SMOTE or use a non-neighbor-based resampling method if any training-fold class has fewer than two samples.
Fit and apply resampling only to the training fold; leave validation and test distributions unchanged.
repairs.root_cause: A fixed k_neighbors value was selected from the full-dataset expectation even though the 99-class training fold contains classes with fewer than k_neighbors plus one samples.
repairs.title: Provisional: configure SMOTE neighbors from the smallest training-fold class
repairs.when_to_use: Use when SMOTE reports that n_neighbors is greater than n_samples_fit for a minority class in a leaf-classification training fold.

repairs.failure_pattern: Loading a validated model checkpoint into the full-data retraining model fails because the checkpoint contains spectral-normalization parameters such as original weights and power-iteration vectors while the destination model exposes ordinary weight keys.
repair_steps: Create validation and full-data model instances through the same model factory.
Apply spectral normalization to the same modules in both instances before saving or loading state.
Verify that source and destination state-dictionary key sets match before calling load_state_dict.
Load strictly after the schemas match, then proceed with full-data retraining or inference.
repairs.root_cause: Spectral normalization changes the module parameterization and state-dictionary schema, but the destination model was constructed without applying the same parameterizations before loading.
repairs.title: Provisional: recreate spectral-normalization parametrizations before checkpoint loading
repairs.when_to_use: Use when a spectrally normalized transformer or classifier checkpoint has normalization-specific keys that are missing from a newly constructed destination model.

repairs.failure_pattern: Multi-scale image feature extraction indexes an intermediate activation as batch-by-token-by-channel, but a forward hook captured a two-dimensional pooled tensor or an incompatible tuple element.
repair_steps: Inspect the documented output contract of each selected SigLIP2 transformer layer.
In the hook, unwrap tuple or structured outputs to the actual hidden-state tensor.
Check the captured tensor rank before removing a class token or pooling across tokens.
Pool only three-dimensional token tensors; handle already pooled two-dimensional embeddings directly or select a layer that exposes token states.
Run one image batch through every selected hook and verify the resulting feature widths before extracting the complete dataset.
repairs.root_cause: The hook assumes every selected vision-transformer layer returns token-level hidden states in the same structure, without normalizing tuple outputs or checking tensor rank.
repairs.title: Provisional: validate transformer-hook output rank before token pooling
repairs.when_to_use: Use when SigLIP2 multi-layer feature extraction raises an indexing error at token slicing because a captured activation has only two dimensions.

repairs.failure_pattern: Mixed-precision training crashes at scaler.scale(loss).backward after constructing a CUDA GradScaler through a deprecated namespace with an argument interpreted under the legacy constructor contract.
repair_steps: Use the device-aware torch.amp GradScaler API consistently with the CUDA device type.
Use the matching torch.amp autocast context in the same training loop.
Enable scaling only when the active device is CUDA, and use ordinary precision behavior otherwise.
Execute one complete optimizer step, including scale, backward, step, and update, before starting the full training schedule.
repairs.root_cause: The training loop mixes the modern device-aware AMP calling convention with the deprecated CUDA-specific GradScaler API.
repairs.title: Provisional: keep mixed-precision scaler and autocast APIs internally consistent
repairs.when_to_use: Use when Phase 1 CUDA training emits an AMP deprecation warning and then fails because the GradScaler constructor received a device string through the legacy API.

repairs.failure_pattern: XGBClassifier training aborts because fit receives early_stopping_rounds as an unsupported keyword before any validation metric is produced.
repair_steps: Inspect the installed XGBClassifier interface before constructing the cross-validation training call.
Move early-stopping configuration to the estimator constructor or supported callback mechanism for that interface, while retaining a validation eval_set.
If early stopping is unnecessary for the final full-data fit, omit it there because no independent validation set is available.
Run one fold and verify that evaluation metrics are recorded and fit completes before launching all folds.
repairs.root_cause: The pipeline uses an early-stopping calling convention from a different XGBoost estimator version than the installed runtime.
repairs.title: Provisional: configure XGBoost early stopping through the installed estimator interface
repairs.when_to_use: Use when multimodal features have been extracted successfully but XGBClassifier.fit rejects early_stopping_rounds as an unexpected keyword.

repairs.failure_pattern: One mutable imputer is repeatedly fitted on margin, shape, and texture training groups, after which validation or test groups are transformed using only the state from the last fitted group.
repair_steps: Create a separate imputer for each of the margin, shape, and texture feature groups.
Fit each imputer only on its corresponding training split or training fold.
Transform the corresponding validation and test group with that same group's fitted imputer.
Apply the same per-group ownership rule to scalers, PCA models, and other stateful transformations.
Assert that every transformed group preserves its expected column count and is produced by the transformer fitted for that group.
repairs.root_cause: Reusing a single fitted transformer across semantically distinct feature groups overwrites its learned statistics and applies texture-derived preprocessing state to margin and shape inputs.
repairs.title: Provisional: isolate fitted preprocessing state by feature group and split
repairs.when_to_use: Use when grouped leaf features are preprocessed separately but one transformer instance is refitted across groups before validation or test transformation.
